plain: Out of about 167 military men who saw UFOs at American nuclear weapons sites, seven or eight say they also met the beings and were taken by them. This comes from Robert Hastings, a researcher who has spent years interviewing veterans for his book UFOs and Nukes. Michels says he asked Hastings how many of his witnesses had close encounters of the third kind, meaning they saw beings and were abducted, not just saw craft over the base. Hastings answered, "seven or eight out of the 167." If true, it would mean these encounters go beyond lights in the sky. In another episode Michels describes the same witnesses as missile security guards and radar operators who saw craft. Richard Barth, a former missile guard who tells of his own abduction, says the book has "like 169 accounts" in it. Hastings puts it in writing in his article "Ex-USAF Security Policeman Tells of Being Abducted by Aliens", dated 16 November 2025: "of the 169 military veterans whom I've interviewed... seven, Barth now makes eight, have also reported experiencing abductions by NHIs", his term for non-human intelligences.
